caseName: Newton v. Brooklyn Union Gas Co.
caseNameFull: Charles D. Newton, as Attorney General of New York v. Brooklyn Union Gas Company
summary: Appeals from the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York.
attorneys: Mr. James A. Donnelly, with whom Mr. John P. O’Brien and Mr. Harry Hertsoff were on the briefs, for Lewis, District Attorney. Mr. Wilber W. Chambers, with whom Mr. Charles D. Newton, Mr. Clarence R. Cummings and Mr. Charles E. Buchner, were on the briefs, for Newton, Attorney General. Mr. William N. Dykrhan, with whom Mr. Jackson A. Dykman and Mr. Edward J. Crummey were on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Affirmed with costs, upon the authority of the New York Gas Cases, ante, 165, 178, 180.
